title: Open issue consolidation into cohesive PR lanes
larger_intended_outcome: Consolidate all 17 open GitHub issues into cohesive dependency-aware implementation lanes and close them through one focused pull request per lane, stacking only where one lane consumes another lane's contracts.
non_goals: Do not create one cross-cutting PR whose review and proof boundary spans unrelated subsystems.
Do not close parent lane issues from partial child fixes; each lane PR must satisfy the parent completion rule.
Do not stack independent lanes merely to share planning artifacts.

candidate_lanes.title: CLI validation and selector contract integrity (#2564, #2574)
candidate_lanes.outcome: Make typed validation failures and selector advertisements mechanically agree with process exit and accepted-selector contracts.
candidate_lanes.proof: Focused root CLI selector, exit-status, session-log, and generated-adapter conformance evidence.
candidate_lanes.slice_contribution_to_parent: Closes the two independent CLI contract bugs without coupling them to broader operating-decision changes.
candidate_lanes.residual_parent_intent: Five subsystem lanes remain after this PR.

candidate_lanes.title: Validation identity and proportional proof receipts (#2553, #2561)
candidate_lanes.outcome: Separate validation run/join/attempt identity and bind proportional proof selection, progress, cost, and freshness to typed receipts.
candidate_lanes.proof: Real Make/pre-commit composition, retry, duplicate, focused-proof, progress, cancellation, and receipt fixtures.
candidate_lanes.slice_contribution_to_parent: Closes the cohesive validation execution and proof-observability issues in one runtime lane.
candidate_lanes.residual_parent_intent: Four subsystem lanes remain after this PR.

candidate_lanes.title: Exact-head one-shot review and safe stack restacking (#2557)
candidate_lanes.outcome: Provide receipt-backed one-shot exact-head review and compare-and-swap stack restacking without weakening the merge gate.
candidate_lanes.proof: Stopped-watcher, stale-review, idempotency, force-with-lease success/failure, and live bounded stack evidence.
candidate_lanes.slice_contribution_to_parent: Closes the isolated review/publication workflow issue in a focused PR.
candidate_lanes.residual_parent_intent: Three product architecture lanes remain after this PR.

candidate_lanes.title: Admitted, revision-bound operating decisions (#2558-#2560, #2562-#2563, #2565-#2567)
candidate_lanes.outcome: Complete the existing operating-decision parent lane across compatibility admission, live-state relevance, scoped ownership, closeout projection, skill activation, and canonical runtime ownership.
candidate_lanes.proof: Cross-surface decision identity, revision invalidation, compatibility, relevance, owner relation, closeout, skill activation, budget, and no-divergence evidence.
candidate_lanes.slice_contribution_to_parent: Closes the central decision architecture lane and establishes the contracts consumed by system-intent and Memory integration.
candidate_lanes.residual_parent_intent: System-intent and Memory lanes remain and stack on this contract where needed.

candidate_lanes.title: Closed-loop system intent drift (#2569)
candidate_lanes.outcome: Make explicit system intent a revision-bound constraint whose drift against operating reality is observable and actionable.
candidate_lanes.proof: Declared/compiled/effective intent identity, drift classification, action routing, and ordinary-path relevance fixtures.
candidate_lanes.slice_contribution_to_parent: Closes the system-intent direction using the admitted operating-decision contract.
candidate_lanes.residual_parent_intent: The Memory lane remains after this PR.

candidate_lanes.title: Decision-effective and self-correcting Memory (#2570-#2572)
candidate_lanes.outcome: Bind applicable durable facts into canonical decisions and close the sparse recurrence, stronger-owner promotion, and retirement loop.
candidate_lanes.proof: Truthful projection states, fact/revision/decision identity, recurrence attribution, consequence integration, promotion, retirement, and quiet-path cost evidence.
candidate_lanes.slice_contribution_to_parent: Closes the final declared parent lane and completes all currently open issue intent.
candidate_lanes.residual_parent_intent: None after all lane proof and issue closure evidence is accepted.

proof_expectations: Each lane PR carries only its declared issues and uses the focused proof selected from its changed paths.
Stacked lane PRs name their exact base PR and rerun proof against the stacked head.
The parent is complete only when all 17 issue completion rules are met and each lane PR has current proof.
promotion_rule: Promote one cohesive lane at a time; independent lanes branch from master, decision-dependent lanes stack on the operating-decision lane, and every lane PR must satisfy all included issue completion rules before closure.
notes: Issue #2564 and draft #2574 form one narrow CLI contract lane. Issues #2553/#2561 form one validation/proof lane. Issue #2557 remains isolated because it mutates publication/review workflows. Parent #2562 owns its architectural children. #2569 and parent #2570 consume the admitted decision boundary and therefore stack on #2562, but not on each other.
